ashcaller_cast.label: Cast starts: lifts the ember over his head
White-hot at the top of the bar
Release: hurls it forward (the Ash Bolt flies)

summoner_cast.label: Release: lashes it out at you (Cinder Lash)
The lash falls back and dies

acolyte_cast.label: Cast starts: lifts the censer high on its chain
Its embers turn purple; shadow gathers above
The orb swells, shadow drawn in
Full: a purple orb over his head
Release: flings it at you (the Shadow Bolt flies)

acolyte_brand.label: Ember Brand (instant): tips the censer down at you
They fall toward the ground (the ring flares under you)

mender_cast.label: Release: hands open, the light bursts out (the hurt ally heals)

chanter_chant.label: Chants (instant): swings the censer out, purple motes rise
Out again, the motes drift up

gwisp_flare.label: Flares (instant): swells white-hot, side flames fanning out
Burns while its ring of fire spreads below
Last pulse as the ring goes off

malrec_cast.label: Ash Bolt starts: lifts the staff
It spills out of the cage, sparks drawn in
Full: a ball of fire over the staff
Release: tips the staff at you (the bolt flies)

malrec_heal.label: Rite of Mending starts: staff planted, he stills
It burns bright, gold motes rising round his hem
Release: a flash of gold along the floor (his hurt ally heals)

prior_grasp.label: Grasp of the Deep starts: lifts the dead lantern high
It glows sea-green, water dripping off it
Release: swings it down, the flood water splashes up (the hands rise)

bellringer_toll.label: Toll starts: heaves the clapper up
Up over his shoulder (step back now!)
Release: slams it into the floor: dust, the toll rings out (stuns anyone close)
